As much as I love physical books, I value an e-reader just as much. When I lived in tiny apartments, my Kindle allowed me to read way more books than my space could hold. And back in college, if there were digital versions of books I needed for class, I would download them all on my Kindle, which saved me so much room in my bag. I’ve had the same paperwhite Kindle since 2015, but the years have definitely taken a toll on the device.
